D1.definitions:
T31-diag D1 — oscillation metrics on the EXECUTED joint trajectory, grasp -> place window.

usage: PYTHONPATH=outputs/verify/T31diag/snap .venv-ag3s/bin/python d1_oscillation.py

Runs: E2 (T28/E2_rec, 6 runs), E3a ep1807 r1 r2 r3, E3b ep1807 r1 r2 (T30).  E3a r2 is extra (task names r1, r3).
grasp_t / place_t : analyze_e0 rules (T28/E0/analyze_e0.py) — grasp = first planning row apple dz >= 50 mm;
                    place = first planning t of the final uninterrupted apple-in-crate streak.
release_t         : first control row t >= place_t with applied_ctrl.gripper[0] >= 0.5 (left gripper opening cmd).
Windows           : W_transport = control rows with grasp_t <= t < place_t ; W_place = place_t <= t <= release_t ;
                    W_all = grasp_t <= t <= release_t.
Signal            : control rows 'qpos' of the left arm (MuJoCo qpos adr 20..26 = left_arm_0..6), dt = 1/15 s (manifest ctrl_hz 15),
                    and separately the commanded 'applied_ctrl.arm' left 7 (same metrics, 'cmd_*').
Metrics (per window):
  sign_reversals      : per joint, velocity v_k = (q_{k+1}-q_k)/dt; count of k where sign(v_k) differs from the sign of the last
                        v with |v| > deadband (deadband 0.02 rad/s); summed over the 7 left-arm joints. Also per second of window.
  jerk_rms            : sqrt(mean over joints x steps of ((q_{k+3}-3q_{k+2}+3q_{k+1}-q_k)/dt^3)^2)  rad/s^3
  fingertip path      : midpoint of MuJoCo bodies ee_finger_l1 / ee_finger_l2 (FK of control-row qpos), world frame.
                        path_length_m, chord_m, path/chord ratio; turning: displacement vectors merged until >= 2 mm,
                        total turning angle (deg) between successive merged segments; mean curvature = total turning (rad) / path length (1/m);
                        n_turns_gt_90deg = merged-segment turns > 90 deg.
  hold                : control rows executed == False — intervals [t_first, t_last], resume t = t_last + 1.
  refined-reference   : planning rows in the window: max over left arm (16D cols 0-6) and executed rows 0-7 of |actions - actions_reference| deg,
                        and the same over both arms (cols 0-6, 8-14).

D3.definitions:
T31-diag D3 — records side of the crate-representation audit.

usage: MUJOCO_GL=osmesa PYTHONPATH=outputs/verify/T31diag/snap .venv-ag3s/bin/python d3_records.py

Part A (all server chunks of the 4 E3 ep1807 runs + E3a r2): per chunk summary fields — n_candidates, esdf_stats.label_names,
  n_static_shapes, destination {source, n_points, extents_mm}, exclusion.mechanism, esdf_stats.target_free.ball (the target-free
  exclusion ball: centre -> nearest GT object centre), esdf_stats.n_attached_points, attached_sign_correction per tier.
Part B (window chunks grasp_t..release_t, same reconstruction as d2_rows_ablation.py incl. attached points):
  B1 held apple left in the field: GT apple centre (planning-row qpos, MuJoCo apple body) -> base; field value at that point per tier
     (fine / coarse; negative = inside a surface); and the number of voxels per tier with |d| <= voxel/2 or d < 0 within
     GT apple bounding radius (apple_geom rbound 56.4 mm) of the apple centre AND farther than 2 voxels from every other GT body
     (crate, table, other fruit; mj_geomDistance probe) — 'apple-only surface voxels'.
  B2 which tier answers the left-hand queries (ee_left, ee_finger_l1/l2 spheres) and held points on the REFERENCE trajectory
     (8 steps): field.answer_tier; 'coarse' split into coarse_in_window (inside the fine window: coarse value < fine value)
     and coarse_outside_window. Counted for all such queries and for those whose GT surface distance to the crate < 50 mm.
     For near-crate queries answered inside the window: median (d_coarse - d_fine) mm.

occupied_voxels_gt_class_E3b_ep1807_r1.definition:
T31-diag D4 — occupied voxels coloured by GT nearest body (the label layer is not recorded).

usage: MUJOCO_GL=osmesa PYTHONPATH=outputs/verify/T31diag/snap .venv-ag3s/bin/python d4_voxels.py RUN T_FIG [--all]
Occupied voxel := recorded grid value d <= voxel/2 (surface or inside), per layer (fine 5 mm: whole window; coarse 20 mm: within the
fine window box + 0.1 m). Voxel centre (base = world here) -> min mj_geomDistance to every collision geom (robot included; geoms
pre-filtered by |centre - p| - rbound < 0.06 m). Class = body of the nearest geom: crate / table / apple / other_fruit / robot /
other; if that distance > 30 mm the class is 'no_gt_surface_30mm'. With --all: the same counts for every window chunk (fine layer).
